# Location

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Location`](gmeow-Location.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Location>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

A locus where an entity can be situated, reside, or occur — a geographic place, an online (virtual) location, a digital storage location, or an astronomical/celestial position.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Location`](gmeow-Location.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
